title: EFC — Master Formal Specification
description: The master formal specification of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), defining the complete theoretical framework comprising the dynamical sector (EFC-D) and structural sector (EFC-S). It derives expansion, rotation curves, lensing, and structure formation from entropy-driven energy flow without invoking dark matter or dark energy, and specifies the entropy-dependent effective light speed coupling all observables.

energy_flow_field.description: The scalar energy-flow field aligns with the negative gradient of the entropy field S, encoding energy transport along entropy-driven channels.

effective_potential.description: The effective potential coupling energy flow and entropy level, with baseline linear case β=1, building the gravitational-like potential landscape.

expansion_rate.description: Effective expansion rate derived from energy-flow magnitude and thermodynamic modulation; late-time acceleration emerges without dark energy.

rotation_velocity.description: Effective circular velocity from the potential gradient; flat rotation curves emerge as thermodynamic signatures without dark matter.

effective_light_speed.description: Entropy-dependent effective speed of light where x(S) = (S - S_mid)/(ΔS/2), creating focusing at low entropy and defocusing at high entropy.

light_travel_time.description: Observed light-travel time along a photon path γ, modulated by the entropy-dependent speed of light c(S).

key_results.main_finding: EFC provides a unified thermodynamic framework where expansion, rotation curves, lensing, and structure formation all emerge from a single entropy-driven energy-flow field without dark matter or dark energy.

sealed_predictions.statement: Mid-entropy regions (S ≈ S_mid) produce the slowest light propagation and longest time delays, creating a measurable stability band for halo-like structures.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Observations showing no correlation between entropy environment and lensing time delays or halo persistence.

sealed_predictions.statement: Flat galaxy rotation curves emerge from entropy-gradient-driven potential Φ(E_f, S) without requiring non-baryonic dark matter halos.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Rotation curve data that cannot be fit by the EFC potential form for any physical parameter values.

sealed_predictions.statement: Late-time cosmic acceleration arises naturally from evolution of (E_f, S) without an external dark-energy component.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Supernova or BAO data requiring a cosmological constant term even after full EFC (E_f, S) fitting.

kill_criteria: KC1: Rotation curves of galaxies cannot be reproduced by the EFC potential gradient ∂Φ/∂r for any physically motivated entropy profile S(r) and energy-flow field E_f(r).
KC2: The entropy-dependent light speed c(S) = c0(1 + a_edge x²) is ruled out by precision measurements of the constancy of c across environments with differing entropy levels.
KC3: Observed expansion history (H(z) from SNIa, BAO, CMB) cannot be fit by H = √|E_f|(1+S) for any monotonic entropy evolution S(z).
KC4: Gravitational lensing profiles show no dual-lens (focusing/defocusing) asymmetry consistent with the s0–s1 entropy endpoint structure.
KC5: Laboratory or astrophysical experiments demonstrate that the speed of light shows zero dependence on local thermodynamic entropy density, ruling out the c(S) mechanism.
